description: §18.0.1 (amended S478) — a block-form `<match>` inside a `<ul>` renders its dispatched arm's `<li>` directly in the `<ul>`, with no wrapper element (`ul > li`, never `ul > div > li`). `for=` is omitted: `on=@phase` is provably of the one enum type `Phase`. A click moves the subject; the other arm's `<li>` takes its place.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S478 "⭐ RULED — open owner questions, PA recs adopted wholesale" items 12 (`for=` may be omitted when `on=` is provably of one enum type) and 13 ("lower it without a wrapper")
rationale: §18.0.1 amended S478: "The dispatched arm's content renders in place of the `<match>`, with no wrapper element around it", so the `<ul>` content model holds; and "`for=` MAY be omitted when `on=` is provably of one enum type". impl#1 still mounts the arms in a `<div data-scrml-match-mount>` (g-impl1-match-mount-wrapper-div-s478).
